    pto::Stride<-1, -1, -1, -1, -1> v271 = pto::Stride<-1, -1, -1, -1, -1>(v266 * v269, v269, v268, v16, v17);
    // pto: %partials_inline119__iter_v1_pview
    ;
    GlobalTensor<float, pto::Shape<1, 1, 1, -1, 32>, pto::Stride<-1, -1, -1, -1, -1>, pto::Layout::ND> v272 = GlobalTensor<float, pto::Shape<1, 1, 1, -1, 32>, pto::Stride<-1, -1, -1, -1, -1>, pto::Layout::ND>(v264 + (v263 + v262 * v16 + v27 * v17), v270, v271);
    wait_flag(PIPE_M, PIPE_FIX, EVENT_ID0);
    TSTORE(v272, v52);
    set_flag(PIPE_FIX, PIPE_M, EVENT_ID0);
  }
  wait_flag(PIPE_MTE1, PIPE_MTE2, EVENT_ID0);
  wait_flag(PIPE_M, PIPE_MTE1, EVENT_ID0);
  wait_flag(PIPE_FIX, PIPE_M, EVENT_ID0);
  wait_flag(PIPE_MTE1, PIPE_MTE2, EVENT_ID2);
  wait_flag(PIPE_MTE1, PIPE_MTE2, EVENT_ID3);
  wait_flag(PIPE_MTE1, PIPE_MTE2, EVENT_ID4);
  wait_flag(PIPE_MTE1, PIPE_MTE2, EVENT_ID5);
  wait_flag(PIPE_M, PIPE_MTE1, EVENT_ID2);
  wait_flag(PIPE_M, PIPE_MTE1, EVENT_ID3);
  #endif // __DAV_CUBE__

  ptoas_auto_sync_tail(PTOAutoSyncTailMode::kBarrierAll);
  return;
}
// --- Kernel entry point ---
extern "C" __aicore__ __attribute__((always_inline)) void kernel_entry(__gm__ int64_t* args)
{
#if !defined(__CPU_SIM) && !defined(__COSTMODEL)
    // Reset AI Core atomic mode inherited from a prior kernel.
    set_atomic_none();
#endif

#if defined(__DAV_CUBE__) && !defined(__CPU_SIM) && !defined(__COSTMODEL)
    // Start cube tasks in FP32 mode, independent of a prior task's HF32 setting.
    set_ctrl(sbitset0(get_ctrl(), pto::MAD_MODE_BIT));
#endif

    // Read logical SPMD block identity from runtime dispatch payload
    int32_t __pypto_spmd_block_idx = get_block_idx(args);
    int32_t __pypto_spmd_block_num = get_block_num(args);

    // Unpack tensor: partials_inline119__ssa_v0
    __gm__ Tensor* partials_inline119__ssa_v0_tensor = reinterpret_cast<__gm__ Tensor*>(args[0]);
    __gm__ float* partials_inline119__ssa_v0 = reinterpret_cast<__gm__ float*>(partials_inline119__ssa_v0_tensor->buffer.addr) + partials_inline119__ssa_v0_tensor->start_offset;

    // Unpack tensor: source__ssa_v0
    __gm__ Tensor* source__ssa_v0_tensor = reinterpret_cast<__gm__ Tensor*>(args[1]);
    __gm__ bfloat16_t* source__ssa_v0 = reinterpret_cast<__gm__ bfloat16_t*>(source__ssa_v0_tensor->buffer.addr) + source__ssa_v0_tensor->start_offset;

    // Unpack tensor: weight__ssa_v0
    __gm__ Tensor* weight__ssa_v0_tensor = reinterpret_cast<__gm__ Tensor*>(args[2]);
    __gm__ bfloat16_t* weight__ssa_v0 = reinterpret_cast<__gm__ bfloat16_t*>(weight__ssa_v0_tensor->buffer.addr) + weight__ssa_v0_tensor->start_offset;

    // Unpack scalar: tokens_inline118__ssa_v0
    union { uint64_t u64; int64_t val; } tokens_inline118__ssa_v0_conv;
    tokens_inline118__ssa_v0_conv.u64 = args[3];
    int64_t tokens_inline118__ssa_v0 = tokens_inline118__ssa_v0_conv.val;

    // Unpack scalar: blocks_inline120__ssa_v0
    union { uint64_t u64; int64_t val; } blocks_inline120__ssa_v0_conv;
    blocks_inline120__ssa_v0_conv.u64 = args[4];
    int64_t blocks_inline120__ssa_v0 = blocks_inline120__ssa_v0_conv.val;

    // Unpack scalar: num_tokens__ssa_v0
    union { uint64_t u64; int32_t val; } num_tokens__ssa_v0_conv;
    num_tokens__ssa_v0_conv.u64 = args[5];
    int32_t num_tokens__ssa_v0 = num_tokens__ssa_v0_conv.val;

    // Forward to ptoas-generated function
    proj_idx_w(partials_inline119__ssa_v0, source__ssa_v0, weight__ssa_v0, tokens_inline118__ssa_v0, blocks_inline120__ssa_v0, num_tokens__ssa_v0, __pypto_spmd_block_idx, __pypto_spmd_block_num);
}
